title: A slide-making project joins the list
summary:
A little garden maintenance: a community slide generator joined the project list, supporter links were fixed, and the logo gained a few colors.

Kushai’s AI PowerPoint Generator was added to the community project list. It turns text input into PowerPoint slides.

Homepage supporter URLs without a protocol now open as HTTPS destinations rather than resolving inside pollinations.ai.

The black logo icon was updated, with red, rose, and turquoise variants added.
